findings.title: Brochure-like description
findings.question: Does otherwise informative prose describe a place or product with stacked promotional praise such as breathtaking, vibrant, renowned, or must-visit instead of relevant descriptive facts?
findings.guidance: Use the supported description and preserve any explicitly requested advertising voice.

findings.title: Unspecified improvement
findings.question: Does the prose claim an improvement or optimization without saying what changed in behavior, capability, or a named measure?
findings.guidance: Describe the supported before-and-after behavior; retain uncertainty and do not invent measurements.

findings.title: Dense generic praise
findings.question: Does a paragraph repeatedly rely on generic praise such as innovative, effective, compelling, remarkable, or sophisticated instead of explaining the properties being praised?
findings.guidance: Cut repeated praise and retain the specific properties already supported.

findings.title: Generic step-forward claim
